title: Maple Crossing — Investment/Sales Offering Memorandum (Revised)
subtitle: Retail asset, Columbus, OH | Revised evaluation date 2026-09-01 | Original fictional evaluation material

sections.heading: Revision Notice & Changes
paragraphs: Source-backed analysis. Assumptions remain subject to diligence.
This revision supersedes the initial memorandum. Changes driven by revision-notice.pdf and rent-roll-revised.xlsx (effective 2026-09-01):
1) Rent roll: Suite 002 monthly rent increased by $225 to $7,025; possession remains active. All other suites unchanged. Suite 010 still vacant.
2) Underwriting rates: cap rate increased 25 bps to 7.0000%; initial sizing rate increased 75 bps to 7.2500%.
3) Prior Suite 001 executed amendment (+$350/mo to $7,000) continues to apply to in-place economics.

4) All other rules (5% economic loss, $350/unit other income, prescribed tax/ins/opex, 3% mgmt of EGI, $300/unit reserves, 65% LTV / 1.25 DSCR / 9% DY, 30-yr amort, 6.00% floor, 1% orig fee, $45,000 closing costs, $4,300,000 payoff) unchanged.

sections.heading: Executive Summary
paragraphs: Maple Crossing is a 10-suite retail property in Columbus, OH comprising 32,150 SF across Small (A), Standard (B) and Large (C) suites. As of the revised roll (2026-09-01), nine suites totaling 29,070 SF are physically occupied; Suite 010 vacant. All active leases expire 2029-08-31; no near-term rollover.

Revised underwriting: GPR $821,400 (all-suite revised scheduled monthly rent x 12) + $3,500 other income; less 5% economic loss = EGI $783,655. NOI (before reserves) = $530,908; NCF = $527,908. Capitalized at 7.0000% -> value $7,584,405 (vs. $7,828,449 prior; the higher cap rate outweighs the modest NOI lift).

Debt sizing at 7.2500% (revised initial rate > 6.00% floor): LTV-bound at $4,929,863; DSCR-bound $5,159,061; DY-bound $5,865,648. Maximum loan = $4,929,863 (LTV binds). Net cash-out = $535,565 after $4,300,000 payoff, $49,299 origination fee and $45,000 closing costs (vs. $692,607 prior).

sections.heading: Property & Suite Mix (unchanged)
paragraphs: Ten in-line retail suites totaling 32,150 SF. Manager group mapping: A = Small (3,080 SF), B = Standard (3,200 SF), C = Large (3,410 SF).

sections.heading: Lease & Occupancy Analysis
paragraphs: Physical occupancy 9/10 units (90.0%); 29,070/32,150 SF (90.4%). Manager 9-of-10 leased headline still conflates pending occupants with physical occupancy.

Suite 001 amendment (executed 2026-07-20, effective 2026-08-01) continues to control: $7,000/mo. Suite 002 revised roll rent now $7,025/mo (per revision notice). In-place annualized contractual rent from the nine active suites = $745,800 ((7,000+7,025+7,075+6,650+6,800+7,075+6,650+6,800+7,075) x 12).
No lease expiration falls within 12 months of the 2026-09-01 evaluation date; earliest expiry 2029-08-31. No free-rent concession. No unsigned rent proposal in the packet.

sections.heading: Historical vs. Underwritten Financials
paragraphs: T12 operating statement covers 2025-09-01 to 2026-08-31; not annualized rent-roll. Roof replacement is capital (booked $0 in repairs); no capital-in-opex misclassification.

sections.heading: Debt Sizing & Sources / Uses (Revised)
paragraphs: Sizing rate = MAX(revised initial 7.2500%, floor 6.00%) = 7.2500%. Annual DS per $1 of principal at 30-yr amort ≈ 0.081861.

sections.heading: Risks & Missing Diligence
paragraphs: Pending-in-occupancy: PRESENT (manager headline still counts pending occupants as leased).
Near-term rollover: ABSENT (earliest expiry 2029-08-31).
Missing insurance: ABSENT (GL policy $2M aggregate through 2027-06-30).
Capital-in-opex classification: ABSENT (roof labeled capital; $0 in repairs).
Unsigned rent change: ABSENT (Suite 001 amendment executed; Suite 002 rent change reflected on revised certified roll).
Temporary free rent: ABSENT (no concession per lease-001).
Sizing-floor binding: ABSENT (revised initial 7.2500% > 6.00% floor; note/initial rate binds).
Refinance shortfall: ABSENT at the sized loan (proceeds $4,929,863 cover $4.3M payoff + fee + closing; positive $535,565 cash-out).
Diligence gaps (routine, not defects): legal, environmental, property condition, title reviews pending; no market rent/sale comps, photos, asking price or sponsor history supplied.
